strengths: Three tabs contain 3,128 populated cells and approximately 300-row HR and payroll populations.
Difficulty arises from population review and cross-source reconciliation rather than hidden calculations.
Filters and frozen panes support ordinary analyst navigation.
defects: Only one formula and limited visible review history make it a source population, not a full workpaper.
No mapping, exception, reconciliation, or reviewer tab.
confidence_limits: The current review did not independently reperform the submission's payroll arithmetic.

patterns: Use realistic employee-level populations, separate event types, and retain source identifiers and dates.
prohibited_content: All employee identities, role facts, dates, amounts, program conclusions, and source identifiers.
sanitization: Generate a new population from approved world facts and a role-specific schema; do not transform existing rows.
proof_gate: Reconcile row counts and totals to the new authority record; inspect filters, types, nulls, and duplicate identifiers.
